about_item: SIZES FOR EVERY BREED - (L, Blue) Available in 7 sizes, ensuring a perfect fit for dogs of all body types and weights. Measure your pet's back using a soft tape measure and refer to the size chart to select the most suitable size for your pup.

DESIGNED FOR WET AND DIRTY PETS: Ideal for quick drying after bath time or during rainy days, providing protection for your carpet and furniture. Great for wrapping your dog after a beach trip or hike to shield your vehicle from mud, dirt, and sand.

SUPER ABSORBENT: Our microfiber dog drying coat has exceptional water-absorbing capabilities, holding over 5 times its weight in water. This makes drying your dog much faster and easier compared to other dog drying robes.

QUICK DRYING: Simply wring out the excess water from the robe and hang it to dry. In just a few hours, it will be ready to use again for your next wet and messy adventure or bath time. The towel coat can also be machine washed and tumble dried.

COMFORTABLE PLUSH FABRIC: The 800 gsm weighted fabric is brushed for maximum softness and plushness. Your pup will love curling up in this cozy towel coat while drying off. It's also finished with a protective and long-lasting cotton trim.

CUSTOM ADJUSTABLE FIT: Our dog towel robes are designed with a wide adjustable belly strap that easily wraps around your dog's underbelly and secures around their body in seconds, ensuring a perfect fit every time you use it.

ELASTIC LEG STRAPS: Quickly pull your dog's legs through the rear elastic straps to keep the bathrobe centered on their back and securely attached to their body, even as they tumble and roll around in their durable dog bath coat.

EXTRA LONG COLLAR: Flip up the collar to quickly dry your dog's neck, ears, and head. Flip it down to provide full range of motion and visibility for your dogs as they run and play in their comfortable bath robes.

PREMIUM VELCRO: Our dog drying robes feature high-quality Velcro that won't pull or attract your dog's fur. It will not stick to the robe or damage the material, ensuring greater durability and a longer lifespan, keeping them fresh and attractive.

WORLD CLASS CUSTOMER SERVICE & 100% SATISFACTION - If you have ANY issues in the first 30 days, Tuff Pupper will REPLACE OR REFUND at no cost to you. All of our products include a hassle free Lifetime Guarantee against manufacturer defects.

authors_reviews.title: lifesaver for weirdo
authors_reviews.text: I bought the XS, gray version of this dog drying coat after struggling to find something that actually fit my oddly-proportioned pup—a long-bodied rescue who never seems to match up with standard sizes. I followed the measuring instructions and checked the size chart, and to my pleasant surprise, it fits perfectly. The adjustable belly strap and elastic leg straps really do make a difference—no more slipping off or bunched-up fabric, even when my dog is rolling around trying to “escape” after baths.This thing is a lifesaver for wet and muddy days. Whether it's after a bath, a rainy walk, or a muddy hike, I just wrap my dog up, pull the straps tight, and let the microfiber do its thing. It absorbs a ton of water—way more than a regular towel—and my dog dries off much faster. I love that I can just wring it out, hang it up, and it’s dry again in a few hours. Plus, it holds up well in the wash—no shrinking or rough spots after several uses.The fabric is thick, soft, and plush, so my dog seems comfortable wearing it (he’ll actually curl up and nap in it sometimes). The extra-long collar is a nice touch for drying off his ears and neck, and it flips down easily if he wants to run around and play. Also, the Velcro is sturdy but doesn’t snag his fur or the fabric, which was a concern for me with similar products.Honestly, I can’t find anything to complain about. The fit is great—even for a dog who’s hard to shop for—the absorbency is next-level, and the design details (like the adjustable straps and flip collar) are super thoughtful. If you’re tired of wet dog smells and muddy paw prints everywhere, this is totally worth it. Plus, knowing there’s a lifetime guarantee gives me peace of mind. Highly recommend for anyone with a dog who loves water or mud as much as mine does. Five stars, easily.
authors_reviews.author: mandy

authors_reviews.title: Love this bathrobe
authors_reviews.text: My dog and I go swimming a lot in the summer and this dog bathrobe is great for afterwards. I towel my dog off before we get into the car after swimming but it never fails that he shakes in the car and then I have to clean the car! Not anymore with this plush, absorbent dog bathrobe! It goes on over my dogs head and then has hind leg straps and a large belly band with Velcro to keep it securely on. The neck part is long and has Velcro too so my dog is securely covered when we get in the car and almost dry when we get out. My dog looks adorable with it on and loves wearing it. I throw it in the washer and the dryer and it comes out great. Nice quality, plush, affordable dog bathrobe at a great price!

authors_reviews.title: Order the next size up for a thick neck!
authors_reviews.text: I bought the bundle with the bath robe and quick dry towel. After I checked the fit and tested the towel and robe, I ordered 3 more bundles, since I have 4 dogs. The towels are very absorbent and have a great design making them easy to hold while drying the dog along with keeping the dog still. The robe is nice and thick compared to other brands. I leave the robe on my dogs for approx 30 minutes after a bath and they are almost completely dry. One issue I did have is the velcro around the neck will open and it has created stress in the neck seem because it slips down Each of the four robes ripped at the front seem. I resewed the logo patch back on without success. I did sew a piece of non-stretchy nylon over the patch which helps, but doesnt allow me to close the neck velcro at all now. Suggestion to be one step ahead of the competition would be to include small strips to cover the velcro when washing them. Washing 4 together, they come out in a tangled mess. Velcro can also stick to other fabrics and cause damage. Limiting the damage the product could possibly cause to itself alone would be an improvement in functionality and definitely help with care and maintenance. I would only have taken off half a star if I could for the issue with the neck seem. Other than that they have been a great value for the money and work great. One more thing is they limit the wet dog smell after a bath since they cover the majority of the dog until dry. Priceless.
authors_reviews.author: missITXX

authors_reviews.title: Wish I'd Bought It Sooner
authors_reviews.text: This thing is actually great. A lot of dogs like to roll in the grass or rub on the furniture after a bath. But my guy makes it his mission to rub and deposit wet dog fur on every single vertical surface in the house. So I ordered this bath robe with the hopes that it would help protect my furniture and painted walls after bath time. I had no expectations that it would serve any other purpose. And it absolutely does help keep my home clean. But it's also really absorbent. Sometimes microfiber-type fabrics really aren't that absorbent, but this bathrobe seemed to suck the water out of my dog's fur. He didn't mind wearing it, and it helped him air dry a lot more quickly because it had already absorbed so much of the water from the furriest parts of his body. It's really easy to slip on over my dog's head, and it attaches around the waist with a wide band and velcro closure. It has a hood you can pull up just over the ears and attach with velcro stripe under the chin. It also has elastic straps that you can slip your dog's back legs through to hold the robe in place down the length of the body, but I didn't find them necessary (I didn't use them). My dog clearly felt it was comfortable, and I think it also helped cut down on post-bath zoomies. When he was rubbing his body all over everything, he was effectively drying himself off because of the robe. Then he laid down and took a nap. I removed the robe about 30 - 45 minutes layer, and the fur underneath was much dryer than I expected, while the inside of the robe itself was quite damp.My dog is 47 lbs with a 26-inch chest. I ordered the XL, and it fits well with room to grown. It's also really stinkin' cute. It's a little pricey, but it's well-made and durable with thick, soft fabric. I'm happy to have it, and I'll be ordering a second one for my older dog as well.
authors_reviews.author: Roozy

authors_reviews.title: High quality, absorbent drying coats!
authors_reviews.text: I love these drying robes, high quality, super absorbent for the price. I have ordered multiple versions for my huskies - they have helped with drying of their fur and prevented a musty smell after swimming. I have used other brand versions but none have held up to the quality and thickness of these robes. Follow the guide for sizing else the length wont be long enough to cover hind area. Added benefit that the pups look adorable and it helps control post swimming zooms.
authors_reviews.author: Brian J. Sevchik
